newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials remain firmer, Nasdaq weaker.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials remain firmer, Nasdaq weaker.

text.p: The Dow Industrials shrugged off their initial paring of early gains to remain higher at mid-morning, but Nasdaq was weaker as some tech stocks dipped.
The Dow was up 16.95 points or 0.22 percent at 7711.61, though barely repairing the 247-point drop suffered Friday.
Nasdaq was off 1.22 points at 1560.81 and has been down for most of the session so far.
The long bond was up 7/32 to yield 6.53 percent, and S&P futures built on earlier gains and were up 6.45 points at 905.25.
The declines on the Big Board edged slightly ahead of the advances, 1289 to 1100.
Despite the big drop in the Dow Friday, some money managers saw little sign of assets being reallocated in investment portfolios.

"We have not seen any and we don't intend to make any," said James Walline, vice president, equities and mutual funds at Lutheran Brotherhood. "The market has stabilized this morning and frankly we don't see any reason to reallocate."
Shares in Hewlett-Packard fell 3-6/16 to 63 after posting earnings below analyst expectations.'
